snippet.title: [OFFICIAL] Scritchy Scratchy - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Scritchy Scratchy is out NOW! 

Get it on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3948120/Scritchy_Scratchy/
Get it on the App Store:
https://apps.apple.com/us/app/scritchy-scratchy/id6758328352
Get it on Google Play: 
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.fundaygames.scritchyscratchy&hl=en

Scritchy Scratchy is a super-satisfying scratch card incremental game. Buy stacks of scratch-offs, unlock auto-scratching, and chase massive jackpots. Will you play it safe or go all-in?

This collaboration is a Funday & Friends special. We are proud to work closely with our fellow Danes at Lunch Money Games on the release of Scritchy Scratchy!

Join the Discord: discord.gg/sr6BvqUkCF
